name: audimo-addons
description: Default community catalog of Audimo addons.

addons.name: YouTube / SoundCloud / Bandcamp
addons.description: Free public web streams. Each service can be toggled individually after install.
addons.author: audimo-addons

addons.name: Soulseek
addons.description: Install slskd and search Soulseek peers directly from the source picker.
addons.author: audimo-addons

addons.name: Indexers + Debrid
addons.description: Six torrent indexers (apibay, bitsearch, torrentdownload, prowlarr, rutracker, audiobookbay) feeding six debrid backends (RD, AllDebrid, TorBox, Premiumize, Debrid-Link, EasyDebrid). After install, paste your debrid API key in the addon's Configure page.
addons.author: audimo-addons

addons.name: Audiobooks
addons.description: Audiobook sources: Internet Archive (free direct streams, no debrid needed), LibriVox (public domain), and AudiobookBay (torrents via debrid or libtorrent).
addons.author: audimo-addons
